subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 2: Central and Inscribed Angles
description: Relate central angles, inscribed angles, and intercepted arcs in circles.
learningObjectives: Identify central angles, inscribed angles, and intercepted arcs
Relate the measure of a central angle to the measure of its intercepted arc
Relate the measure of an inscribed angle to half the measure of its intercepted arc
Use angle-arc relationships to solve for missing measures in circles
Explain common errors when comparing central and inscribed angles
prerequisites: Recognizing parts of a circle such as center, radius, chord, and arc
Understanding that a full circle measures 360 degrees
